summary: N-able, Inc. filed an 8-K on July 13, 2026, reporting the departure of Chief Revenue Officer Frank Colletti effective July 9, 2026, and the immediate appointment of Russell Rosa as his successor. The filing cites Item 5.02 for director/officer changes and Item 8.01 for other events. No specific price per share, premium, stake size, or deal value was disclosed. The event is a management reshuffle, not a special-situation transaction. The board did not issue a recommendation or name advisors. Watch for subsequent modifications to severance benefits.
